name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for model airplanes, eventually leading to a deep understanding of aerodynamics and material science. He honed his skills at a local automotive shop, specializing in carbon fiber repair and custom fabrication. Kenji's meticulous approach to composite work quickly gained recognition, and he was recruited by Vee Masters to bolster their technical team.

Within Vee Masters, Kenji is known for his unwavering dedication to perfection. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can compromise the performance of a race car, pushing him to demand the highest standards from himself and his colleagues. His experience with various composite materials, combined with a sharp eye for detail, makes him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring the cars are both lightweight and durable.

Kenji's distinctive approach lies in his integration of traditional Japanese craftsmanship with modern composite technology. He often incorporates techniques learned from his grandfather, a master woodworker, to ensure the structural integrity and aesthetic appeal of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left side
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a wiry build, always wearing safety glasses.

Insists on using traditional Japanese measuring tools alongside digital instruments.
